lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
integration_itop-reference: 19,465 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 18,763 B, generated by rollup 279 B, generated by vite 204 B.
css holds 3 stylesheets, 72,762 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.
Loaded from PHP: admin-settings.css (templates/adminSettings.php), personal-settings.css (templates/personalSettings.php).
Imported by a source file, so they reach the browser through the bundle and not as this file: dashboard.css (src/views/DashboardWidget.css).
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,508 B on the integration_itop-reference page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
1,479,003 B in 4,376 pieces of 6 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
